name: Swinging
description: Allows the entity to swing from anchor points, similar to a grappling hook.

fields.description: The maximum height for anchor points.
Determines if the maximum height for anchors are relative to the ground, or a fixed y-level.
The range of distances from the anchor point that the entity can swing at. It can either be a single, fixed number, or an array of 2 numbers that the player can adjust between while swinging.
The time (in ticks) the player must be moving forward before a new anchor point is created.
Settings for the swinging flight animation.

name: Default Flight
description: Default flying type. If the sprint speed is equal or less than the normal speed, this flight will be levitation-only.

fields.description: The sprinting flight speed. If not set, it will be equal to the normal speed.
The animation settings for this flight type.
